title: token-efficiency.md's today's figure of 12 tools and 12,416 characters is not what the default server's tools/list holds
goal: the tools/list figure in kb/_self/token-efficiency.md counts the tools the measuring command lists today, including kb_backlog, kb_querylog and kb_docs, or is worded as a dated measurement that names the tools it counted

run: import json,subprocess,sys;p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kb_mcp.py'],input=json.dumps({'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':1,'method':'tools/list'})+'\n',capture_output=True,text=True);assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr;t=json.loads(p.stdout)['result']['tools'];n=len(json.dumps(t,separators=(',',':')));d=open('kb/_self/token-efficiency.md',encoding='utf-8').read();m='Today'+chr(39)+'s figure.** ';assert m not in d or (m+'%d tools and %s characters'%(len(t),format(n,','))) in d,'token-efficiency.md gives a tool count and size that the default server does not list: %d tools, %d characters'%(len(t),n)
